description: Cofounder dispatches a lead-sourcing run (count 2). Outreach-agent claims the ticket, runs the signal-first ladder (exa semantic LinkedIn search, GitHub-stars check via web_fetch, hiring check via web_search), verifies each profile in the LinkedIn browser identity, dedupes against the MEMORY.md pipeline ledger and appends the qualified rows there (file work — no tool event), and completes with result + digest. No sequence touches are sent — that is run_campaign's job. No vault reads: the squad declares no secrets.

inputs.icp: Head of Growth at B2B SaaS, 20-100 ppl, just raised a seed round

dispatch.title: Source 2 leads: heads of growth, fresh seed rounds

args.title: Source 2 leads: heads of growth, fresh seed rounds

args.query: B2B SaaS seed round announced June 2026 20-100 employees
LinkedIn profiles: Head of Growth at B2B SaaS company that raised a seed round in the last 30 days

args.purpose: confirm the funding signal + headcount range for candidate 1
confirm the funding signal + headcount range for candidate 2

args.comment: 2/2 leads qualified on the funding signal, deduped against Active + Closed leads, rows appended to the pipeline ledger with Next due = today.

args.result: Sourced 2 ICP-qualified leads on the funding signal (Heads of Growth at 20-100-person B2B SaaS, seed rounds closed this month). Both verified on LinkedIn, deduped against the pipeline, and appended to Pipeline → Active leads in MEMORY.md as `queued` with Next due today so Touch 1 fires on the next outbound pass.
args.digest: Ran outreach.find_leads: 2/2 qualified (funding signal). One candidate rejected — role was 'Growth Marketing Manager', not Head of Growth; bar held. Next wake: Touch 1 for both queued rows in the daily loop.
